products.name: Browse AI
products.note: Web scraping automation; data extraction; monitoring; terms-of-service compliance risk

profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and website monitoring platform. The company describes itself as a tool that lets users extract data from websites, track webpage changes, and connect that data to external databases or automation workflows through a REST API, all through a point-and-click interface that requires no programming. Its core pitch is that an AI-powered change detection system automatically adapts scraping robots when a target website's structure changes, reducing the breakage that the company says affects traditional scrapers and Python scripts.

The platform's main product, also called Browse AI, falls in the automation and agents category and covers web scraping, data extraction, monitoring, and integration. Features the company highlights include dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, and rate limiting. Pre-built robot templates are offered for specific sites and use cases, including product and pricing data extraction from retail listings and bulk text translation via Google Translate. The site notes a terms-of-service compliance risk associated with the product, which is worth bearing in mind for potential users depending on the sites they intend to scrape.

The held facts record no litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations for Browse AI at this time.
